Game Overview

At its heart, Robot Attacks is a hyper-casual game about defend your city in the thrilling arcade frenzy of Robot Attacks. Battle escalating waves of mechanical monstrosities with lightning-fast clicks or taps. Strategize to fortify your base and harness power-ups for survival. Test your reflexes in this high-stakes showdown where every second counts.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Robot Attacks is easy to pick up. Defend your city in the thrilling arcade frenzy of Robot Attacks. Battle escalating waves of mechanical monstrosities with lightning-fast clicks or taps. Strategize to fortify your base and harness power-ups for survival. Test your reflexes in this high-stakes showdown where every second counts.
